name: project-architect
description: Architecture-aware Codex plugin: injects current project structure every turn and makes reuse-before-write the default workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Understand project structure every turn and reuse existing code.
interface.longDescription: Injects a compact project architecture summary into Codex at session start and before every user prompt. Provides MCP tools for searching reusable code, registering new scripts, and keeping the architecture index fresh.
defaultPrompt: 先查看当前项目架构，再开始开发
